arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُزَّمِّلُ
transliteration: Yaw ayyuhal muzzammil

translations.en.sahih: O you who wraps himself [in clothing],
translations.en.pickthall: O thou wrapped up in thy raiment!
translations.en.yusufali: O thou folded in garments!
translations.id.indonesian: Hai orang yang berselimut (Muhammad),

arabic: قُمِ ٱلَّيْلَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا
transliteration: Qumil laila illaa qaleelaa

translations.en.sahih: Arise [to pray] the night, except for a little -
translations.en.pickthall: Keep vigil the night long, save a little -
translations.en.yusufali: Stand (to prayer) by night, but not all night,-
translations.id.indonesian: bangunlah (untuk sembahyang) di malam hari, kecuali sedikit (daripadanya),

arabic: نِّصْفَهُۥٓ أَوِ ٱنقُصْ مِنْهُ قَلِيلًا
transliteration: Nisfahooo awinqus minhu qaleelaa

translations.en.sahih: Half of it - or subtract from it a little
translations.en.pickthall: A half thereof, or abate a little thereof
translations.en.yusufali: Half of it,- or a little less,
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu) seperduanya atau kurangilah dari seperdua itu sedikit.

arabic: أَوْ زِدْ عَلَيْهِ وَرَتِّلِ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَرْتِيلًا
transliteration: Aw zid 'alaihi wa rattilil Qur'aana tarteela

translations.en.sahih: Or add to it, and recite the Qur'an with measured recitation.
translations.en.pickthall: Or add (a little) thereto - and chant the Qur'an in measure,
translations.en.yusufali: Or a little more; and recite the Qur'an in slow, measured rhythmic tones.
translations.id.indonesian: atau lebih dari seperdua itu. Dan bacalah Al Quran itu dengan perlahan-lahan.

arabic: إِنَّا سَنُلْقِى عَلَيْكَ قَوْلًۭا ثَقِيلًا
transliteration: Innaa sanulqee 'alika qawalan saqeelaa

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We will cast upon you a heavy word.
translations.en.pickthall: For we shall charge thee with a word of weight.
translations.en.yusufali: Soon shall We send down to thee a weighty Message.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Kami akan menurunkan kapadamu perkataan yang berat.

arabic: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيْلِ هِىَ أَشَدُّ وَطْـًۭٔا وَأَقْوَمُ قِيلًا
transliteration: Inn naashi'atal laili hiya ashadddu wat anw wa aqwamu qeelaa

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! the vigil of the night is (a time) when impression is more keen and speech more certain.
translations.en.yusufali: Truly the rising by night is most potent for governing (the soul), and most suitable for (framing) the Word (of Prayer and Praise).
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya bangun di waktu malam adalah lebih tepat (untuk khusyu') dan bacaan di waktu itu lebih berkesan.

arabic: إِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبْحًۭا طَوِيلًۭا
transliteration: Inna laka fin nahaari sabhan taweelaa

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! thou hast by day a chain of business.
translations.en.yusufali: True, there is for thee by day prolonged occupation with ordinary duties:
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya kamu pada siang hari mempunyai urusan yang panjang (banyak).

arabic: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلًۭا
transliteration: Wazkuris ma rabbika wa tabattal ilaihi tabteelaa

translations.en.sahih: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion.
translations.en.pickthall: So remember the name of thy Lord and devote thyself with a complete devotion -
translations.en.yusufali: But keep in remembrance the name of thy Lord and devote thyself to Him whole-heartedly.
translations.id.indonesian: Sebutlah nama Tuhanmu, dan beribadatlah kepada-Nya dengan penuh ketekunan.

arabic: رَّبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيلًۭا
transliteration: Rabbul mashriqi wal maghriibi laaa ilaaha illaa Huwa fattakhizhu wakeelaa

translations.en.sahih: [He is] the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of [your] affairs.
translations.en.pickthall: Lord of the East and the West; there is no Allah save Him; so choose thou Him alone for thy defender -
translations.en.yusufali: (He is) Lord of the East and the West: there is no god but He: take Him therefore for (thy) Disposer of Affairs.
translations.id.indonesian: (Dialah) Tuhan masyrik dan maghrib, tiada Tuhan (yang berhak disembah) melainkan Dia, maka ambillah Dia sebagai pelindung.

arabic: وَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱهْجُرْهُمْ هَجْرًۭا جَمِيلًۭا
transliteration: Wasbir 'alaa maa yaqoo loona wahjurhum hajran jameelaa

translations.en.sahih: And be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance.
translations.en.pickthall: And bear with patience what they utter, and part from them with a fair leave-taking.
translations.en.yusufali: And have patience with what they say, and leave them with noble (dignity).
translations.id.indonesian: Dan bersabarlah terhadap apa yang mereka ucapkan dan jauhilah mereka dengan cara yang baik.

arabic: وَذَرْنِى وَٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُو۟لِى ٱلنَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا
transliteration: Wa zarnee walmukaz zibeena ulin na'mati wa mahhilhum qaleelaa

translations.en.sahih: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little.
translations.en.pickthall: Leave Me to deal with the deniers, lords of ease and comfort (in this life); and do thou respite them awhile.
translations.en.yusufali: And leave Me (alone to deal with) those in possession of the good things of life, who (yet) deny the Truth; and bear with them for a little while.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan biarkanlah Aku (saja) bertindak terhadap orang-orang yang mendustakan itu, orang-orang yang mempunyai kemewahan dan beri tangguhlah mereka barang sebentar.

arabic: إِنَّ لَدَيْنَآ أَنكَالًۭا وَجَحِيمًۭا
transliteration: Inna ladainaaa ankaalanw wa jaheemaa

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, with Us [for them] are shackles and burning fire
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! with Us are heavy fetters and a raging fire,
translations.en.yusufali: With Us are Fetters (to bind them), and a Fire (to burn them),
translations.id.indonesian: Karena sesungguhnya pada sisi Kami ada belenggu-belenggu yang berat dan neraka yang menyala-nyala.

arabic: وَطَعَامًۭا ذَا غُصَّةٍۢ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمًۭا
transliteration: Wa ta'aaman zaa ghussa tinw wa'azaaban aleemaa

translations.en.sahih: And food that chokes and a painful punishment -
translations.en.pickthall: And food which choketh (the partaker), and a painful doom
translations.en.yusufali: And a Food that chokes, and a Penalty Grievous.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan makanan yang menyumbat di kerongkongan dan azab yang pedih.

arabic: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًۭا مَّهِيلًا
transliteration: Yawma tarjuful ardu waljibaalu wa kaanatil jibaalu kaseebam maheelaa

translations.en.sahih: On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down.
translations.en.pickthall: On the day when the earth and the hills rock, and the hills become a heap of running sand.
translations.en.yusufali: One Day the earth and the mountains will be in violent commotion. And the mountains will be as a heap of sand poured out and flowing down.
translations.id.indonesian: Pada hari bumi dan gunung-gunung bergoncangan, dan menjadilah gunung-gunung itu tumpukan-tumpukan pasir yang berterbangan.

arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًۭا شَٰهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًۭا
transliteration: Innaa arsalnaaa ilaikum rasoolan shahidan 'alikum kamaaa arsalnaaa ilaa Fir'awna Rasoolna

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! We have sent unto you a messenger as witness against you, even as We sent unto Pharaoh a messenger.
translations.en.yusufali: We have sent to you, (O men!) a messenger, to be a witness concerning you, even as We sent a messenger to Pharaoh.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Kami telah mengutus kepada kamu (hai orang kafir Mekah) seorang Rasul, yang menjadi saksi terhadapmu, sebagaimana Kami telah mengutus (dahulu) seorang Rasul kepada Fir'aun.

arabic: فَعَصَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَٰهُ أَخْذًۭا وَبِيلًۭا
transliteration: Fa'asaa Fir'awnur Rasoola fa akhaznaahu akhzanw wabeelaa

translations.en.sahih: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a ruinous seizure.
translations.en.pickthall: But Pharaoh rebelled against the messenger, whereupon We seized him with no gentle grip.
translations.en.yusufali: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger; so We seized him with a heavy Punishment.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka Fir'aun mendurhakai Rasul itu, lalu Kami siksa dia dengan siksaan yang berat.

arabic: فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًۭا يَجْعَلُ ٱلْوِلْدَٰنَ شِيبًا
transliteration: Fakaifa tattaqoona in kafartum yawmany yaj'alul wildaana sheeba

translations.en.sahih: Then how can you fear, if you disbelieve, a Day that will make the children white- haired?
translations.en.pickthall: Then how, if ye disbelieve, will ye protect yourselves upon the day which will turn children grey,
translations.en.yusufali: Then how shall ye, if ye deny (Allah), guard yourselves against a Day that will make children hoary-headed?-
translations.id.indonesian: Maka bagaimanakah kamu akan dapat memelihara dirimu jika kamu tetap kafir kepada hari yang menjadikan anak-anak beruban.

arabic: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌۢ بِهِۦ ۚ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَفْعُولًا
transliteration: Assamaaa'u munfatirum bih; kaana wa'duhoo maf'oola

translations.en.sahih: The heaven will break apart therefrom; ever is His promise fulfilled.
translations.en.pickthall: The very heaven being then rent asunder. His promise is to be fulfilled.
translations.en.yusufali: Whereon the sky will be cleft asunder? His Promise needs must be accomplished.
translations.id.indonesian: Langit(pun) menjadi pecah belah pada hari itu. Adalah janji-Nya itu pasti terlaksana.

arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
transliteration: Inna haazihee tazkiratun fa man shaaa'at takhaza ilaa Rabbihee sabeelaa

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his Lord a way.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! This is a Reminder. Let him who will, then, choose a way unto his Lord.
translations.en.yusufali: Verily this is an Admonition: therefore, whoso will, let him take a (straight) path to his Lord!
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya ini adalah suatu peringatan. Maka barangsiapa yang menghendaki niscaya ia menempuh jalan (yang menyampaikannya) kepada Tuhannya.

arabic: ۞ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَىِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرْضَىٰ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ ۚ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًۭا ۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍۢ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرًۭا وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْرًۭا ۚ وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۢ
transliteration: Inna Rabbaka ya'lamu annaka taqoomu adnaa min sulusa yil laili wa nisfahoo wa sulusahoo wa taaa'ifatum minal lazeena ma'ak; wal laahu yuqaddirul laila wanna haar; 'alima al lan tuhsoohu fataaba 'alaikum faqra'oo maa tayassara minal quraan; 'alima an sa yakoonu minkum mardaa wa aakharoona yadriboona fil ardi yabtaghoona min fadlil laahi wa aakharoona yuqaatiloona fee sabeelil laahi faqra'oo ma tayassara minhu wa aqeemus salaata wa aatuz zakaata wa aqridul laaha qardan hasanaa; wa maa tuqadimoo li anfusikum min khairin tajidoohu 'indal laahi huwa khayranw wa a'zama ajraa; wastaghfirul laahaa innal laaha ghafoorur raheem.

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muhammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And Allah determines [the extent of] the night and the day. He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur'an. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allah and others fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakah and loan Allah a goodly loan. And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allah. It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allah. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! thy Lord knoweth how thou keepest vigil sometimes nearly two-thirds of the night, or (sometimes) half or a third thereof, as do a party of those with thee. Allah measureth the night and the day. He knoweth that ye count it not, and turneth unto you in mercy. Recite, then, of the Qur'an that which is easy for you. He knoweth that there are sick folk among you, while others travel in the land in search of Allah's bounty, and others (still) are fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite of it that which is easy (for you), and establish worship and pay the poor-due, and (so) lend unto Allah a goodly loan. Whatsoever good ye send before you for your souls, ye will find it with Allah, better and greater in the recompense. And seek forgiveness of Allah. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
translations.en.yusufali: Thy Lord doth know that thou standest forth (to prayer) nigh two-thirds of the night, or half the night, or a third of the night, and so doth a party of those with thee. But Allah doth appoint night and day in due measure He knoweth that ye are unable to keep count thereof. So He hath turned to you (in mercy): read ye, therefore, of the Qur'an as much as may be easy for you. He knoweth that there may be (some) among you in ill-health; others travelling through the land, seeking of Allah's bounty; yet others fighting in Allah's Cause, read ye, therefore, as much of the Qur'an as may be easy (for you); and establish regular Prayer and give regular Charity; and loan to Allah a Beautiful Loan. And whatever good ye send forth for your souls ye shall find it in Allah's Presence,- yea, better and greater, in Reward and seek ye the Grace of Allah: for Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Tuhanmu mengetahui bahwasanya kamu berdiri (sembahyang) kurang dari dua pertiga malam, atau seperdua malam atau sepertiganya dan (demikian pula) segolongan dari orang-orang yang bersama kamu. Dan Allah menetapkan ukuran malam dan siang. Allah mengetahui bahwa kamu sekali-kali tidak dapat menentukan batas-batas waktu-waktu itu, maka Dia memberi keringanan kepadamu, karena itu bacalah apa yang mudah (bagimu) dari Al Quran. Dia mengetahui bahwa akan ada di antara kamu orang-orang yang sakit dan orang-orang yang berjalan di muka bumi mencari sebagian karunia Allah; dan orang-orang yang lain lagi berperang di jalan Allah, maka bacalah apa yang mudah (bagimu) dari Al Quran dan dirikanlah sembahyang, tunaikanlah zakat dan berikanlah pinjaman kepada Allah pinjaman yang baik. Dan kebaikan apa saja yang kamu perbuat untuk dirimu niscaya kamu memperoleh (balasan)nya di sisi Allah sebagai balasan yang paling baik dan yang paling besar pahalanya. Dan mohonlah ampunan kepada Allah; sesungguhnya Allah Maha Pengampun lagi Maha Penyayang.
